title: When anger dresses itself as discipline
subtitle: When anger disguises itself as seriousness
description: Hold anger beside discipline until you can hear the difference between governed strength and heat wearing a moral face.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Discipline governs heat; it does not borrow its voice.
heroSource.lifeApplication: When anger starts calling itself seriousness, slow the body before naming it discipline.
